text:
Predicates:
IstanbulPlate(x) ::: x is a vehicle registration plate from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(x, y) ::: x begins with the number y.
Joe(x) ::: x is Joe.
Tom(x) ::: x is Tom.
PlateOf(x, y) ::: y is the license plate of x.
Year35(x) ::: x begins with the number 35.
Premises:
∀x (IstanbulPlate(x) → BeginsWith(x, 34)) ::: All plates from Istanbul begin with 34.
∀x (¬IstanbulPlate(x) → ¬BeginsWith(x, 34)) ::: Plates not from Istanbul do not begin with 34.
PlateOf(Joe, p) ::: Joe's vehicle registration plate is p.
IstanbulPlate(p) ::: p is a plate from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(p, 35) ::: p begins with 35.
If BeginsWith(p, 35) then ¬BeginsWith(p, 34) ::: If a plate begins with 35, then it does not begin with 34.
Conclusion:
PlateOf(Joe, p) ∧ IstanbulPlate(p) → BeginsWith(p, 34) ::: Joe's license plate begins with 34.
